-- Refactor course schema: normalize i18n, tech, and compose_config
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    label varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compose_config (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    config jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_compose_config_config ON compose_config (config);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compose_config_tech (
    compose_config_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES compose_config(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tech_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (compose_config_id, tech_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_tech (
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tech_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tech(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (course_id, tech_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_i18n (
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (course_id, i18n_id)
);

ALTER TABLE course ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS main_tech_id uuid NULL;
ALTER TABLE course ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS current_version_id uuid NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_course_main_tech') THEN
        ALTER TABLE course ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_main_tech FOREIGN KEY (main_tech_id) REFERENCES tech(id);
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_course_current_version') THEN
        ALTER TABLE course ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_current_version FOREIGN KEY (current_version_id) REFERENCES course_version(id);
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS compose_config_id uuid NULL;
ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS published_at timestamptz NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_course_version_compose_config') THEN
        ALTER TABLE course_version ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_version_compose_config FOREIGN KEY (compose_config_id) REFERENCES compose_config(id);
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Seed tech from existing labels (if legacy columns exist)
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'tech_label'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            INSERT INTO tech (id, label, created_at)
            SELECT uuid_generate_v4(), cv.tech_label, now()
            FROM course_version cv
            WHERE cv.tech_label IS NOT NULL AND cv.tech_label <> ''
            ON CONFLICT (label) DO NOTHING
        $sql$;
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'main_tech'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            INSERT INTO tech (id, label, created_at)
            SELECT uuid_generate_v4(), cv.main_tech, now()
            FROM course_version cv
            WHERE cv.main_tech IS NOT NULL AND cv.main_tech <> ''
            ON CONFLICT (label) DO NOTHING
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Create compose_config rows per course_version and link (if legacy compose_config exists)
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course' AND column_name = 'compose_config'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            WITH source AS (
                SELECT
                    cv.id AS course_version_id,
                    COALESCE(c.compose_config, '{}'::jsonb) AS config
                FROM course_version cv
                JOIN course c ON c.id = cv.course_id
            ),
            ins AS (
                INSERT INTO compose_config (id, config, created_at)
                SELECT uuid_generate_v4(), config, now()
                FROM source
                ON CONFLICT (config) DO NOTHING
            )
            UPDATE course_version cv
            SET compose_config_id = cc.id
            FROM source s
            JOIN compose_config cc ON cc.config = s.config
            WHERE cv.id = s.course_version_id
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Map course main tech from current/default version (if legacy columns exist)
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'main_tech'
    ) AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'tech_label'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            WITH ranked AS (
                SELECT
                    c.id AS course_id,
                    COALESCE(cv.main_tech, cv.tech_label) AS label,
                    cv.published_at,
                    cv.version,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY c.id
                        ORDER BY (cv.published_at IS NOT NULL) DESC, cv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, cv.version DESC
                    ) AS rn
                FROM course c
                JOIN course_version cv ON cv.course_id = c.id
                WHERE cv.is_default = true OR cv.id = c.current_version_id
            )
            UPDATE course c
            SET main_tech_id = t.id
            FROM ranked r
            JOIN tech t ON t.label = r.label
            WHERE c.id = r.course_id AND r.rn = 1
        $sql$;
    ELSIF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'main_tech'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            WITH ranked AS (
                SELECT
                    c.id AS course_id,
                    cv.main_tech AS label,
                    cv.published_at,
                    cv.version,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY c.id
                        ORDER BY (cv.published_at IS NOT NULL) DESC, cv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, cv.version DESC
                    ) AS rn
                FROM course c
                JOIN course_version cv ON cv.course_id = c.id
                WHERE cv.is_default = true OR cv.id = c.current_version_id
            )
            UPDATE course c
            SET main_tech_id = t.id
            FROM ranked r
            JOIN tech t ON t.label = r.label
            WHERE c.id = r.course_id AND r.rn = 1
        $sql$;
    ELSIF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'tech_label'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            WITH ranked AS (
                SELECT
                    c.id AS course_id,
                    cv.tech_label AS label,
                    cv.published_at,
                    cv.version,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY c.id
                        ORDER BY (cv.published_at IS NOT NULL) DESC, cv.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, cv.version DESC
                    ) AS rn
                FROM course c
                JOIN course_version cv ON cv.course_id = c.id
                WHERE cv.is_default = true OR cv.id = c.current_version_id
            )
            UPDATE course c
            SET main_tech_id = t.id
            FROM ranked r
            JOIN tech t ON t.label = r.label
            WHERE c.id = r.course_id AND r.rn = 1
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Fill course_tech with all distinct techs from versions (if legacy columns exist)
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'tech_label'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            INSERT INTO course_tech (course_id, tech_id)
            SELECT DISTINCT cv.course_id, t.id
            FROM course_version cv
            JOIN tech t ON t.label = cv.tech_label
            WHERE cv.tech_label IS NOT NULL AND cv.tech_label <> ''
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
        $sql$;
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'main_tech'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            INSERT INTO course_tech (course_id, tech_id)
            SELECT DISTINCT cv.course_id, t.id
            FROM course_version cv
            JOIN tech t ON t.label = cv.main_tech
            WHERE cv.main_tech IS NOT NULL AND cv.main_tech <> ''
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Link compose_config to tech via versions (if legacy columns exist)
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'tech_label'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            INSERT INTO compose_config_tech (compose_config_id, tech_id)
            SELECT DISTINCT cv.compose_config_id, t.id
            FROM course_version cv
            JOIN tech t ON t.label = cv.tech_label
            WHERE cv.compose_config_id IS NOT NULL AND cv.tech_label IS NOT NULL AND cv.tech_label <> ''
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
        $sql$;
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_version' AND column_name = 'main_tech'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            INSERT INTO compose_config_tech (compose_config_id, tech_id)
            SELECT DISTINCT cv.compose_config_id, t.id
            FROM course_version cv
            JOIN tech t ON t.label = cv.main_tech
            WHERE cv.compose_config_id IS NOT NULL AND cv.main_tech IS NOT NULL AND cv.main_tech <> ''
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Migrate localized texts into course_i18n from default/current versions (if legacy table exists)
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.course_version_i18n') IS NOT NULL THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            WITH candidates AS (
                SELECT
                    c.id AS course_id,
                    cv.id AS course_version_id,
                    cv.version,
                    cv.published_at,
                    cvi.i18n_id,
                    cvi.title,
                    cvi.description
                FROM course c
                JOIN course_version cv ON cv.course_id = c.id
                JOIN course_version_i18n cvi ON cvi.course_version_id = cv.id
                WHERE cv.is_default = true OR cv.id = c.current_version_id
            ),
            ranked AS (
                SELECT
                    *,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY course_id, i18n_id
                        ORDER BY (published_at IS NOT NULL) DESC, published_at DESC NULLS LAST, version DESC
                    ) AS rn
                FROM candidates
            )
            INSERT INTO course_i18n (course_id, i18n_id, title, description)
            SELECT course_id, i18n_id, title, description
            FROM ranked
            WHERE rn = 1
            ON CONFLICT (course_id, i18n_id) DO UPDATE SET
                title = EXCLUDED.title,
                description = EXCLUDED.description
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Drop old localized table and obsolete columns
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS course_version_i18n;

ALTER TABLE course DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS compose_config;
ALTER TABLE course DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS title;
ALTER TABLE course DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS description;

ALTER TABLE course_version DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS title;
ALTER TABLE course_version DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS description;
ALTER TABLE course_version DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS tech_label;
ALTER TABLE course_version DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS main_tech;
ALTER TABLE course_version DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS main_tech_version;

-- Indexes for new foreign keys
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_main_tech_id ON course(main_tech_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_version_compose_config_id ON course_version(compose_config_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_i18n_course_id ON course_i18n(course_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_i18n_i18n_id ON course_i18n(i18n_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_tech_course_id ON course_tech(course_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_tech_tech_id ON course_tech(tech_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compose_config_tech_compose_config_id ON compose_config_tech(compose_config_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compose_config_tech_tech_id ON compose_config_tech(tech_id);

COMMIT;
